negative_snippets:
I am extremely disappointed with the way your reception staff behaved with me during my inquiry call.

When I asked about room availability, the lady at the reception spoke very rudely. She directly said “Don’t come, the room is not available” in a harsh tone. I simply told her that I prefer paying at the hotel instead of online, but instead of guiding me politely, she kept insisting rudely and then refused the booking.

Not only this, she was speaking in a very uncivil, slang-type language (more like street tone bihari language rather than professional English/Hindi), which is highly unprofessional for someone representing your hotel. A receptionist is the face of the property, and such rude behavior can completely spoil the reputation of your hotel.

I request you to kindly take strict action regarding this staff member, because with such behavior, guests will only walk away and never recommend this hotel.
